scripts.export:sam: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra export python -m parfocal_ml.sam_onnx.export
scripts.parity:fixture: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra export python -m parfocal_ml.sam_onnx.parity_fixture
scripts.verify:sam: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra export python -m parfocal_ml.sam_onnx.verify
scripts.test:weights: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra export pytest tests/test_sam_onnx.py tests/test_interactive.py tests/test_ais_region.py tests/test_prompt_region.py -m weights -q
scripts.test:tumor: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra tumor --all-groups pytest tests/test_stored_slides.py -m 'not db' -q
scripts.test:accuracy: PARFOCAL_REQUIRE_WEIGHTS=1 uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra export pytest tests -m 'not db' -q --continue-on-collection-errors
scripts.bench:ais-region: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra onnx python -m parfocal_ml.ais_region
scripts.bench:prompt-region: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra onnx python -m parfocal_ml.prompt_region
scripts.bench:exemplar-search: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra onnx python -m parfocal_ml.exemplar_search
scripts.dashboard: cd ../.. && uv run --package parfocal-ml python -m parfocal_ml.dashboard
scripts.bench:interactive: uv run --package parfocal-ml --extra onnx python -m parfocal_ml.interactive
